$schema_note: RetroForge ticket board. Fields: id, title, phase (roadmap phase), crate (primary write scope), write_scope (globs the executor may touch), depends_on (ticket ids), acceptance (ALL must pass before status=done), points (fibonacci), status (todo|in_progress|done|blocked), notes (OPTIONAL array of strings, append-only: HANDOFF:/BLOCKED: entries). ALWAYS-WRITABLE SET (in addition to write_scope, for every ticket): this file's own-ticket status+notes fields; docs/STATUS.md (append one line per merged ticket); Cargo.lock; docs/TECH_STACK.md section-2 rows (new-dependency decision record). Claim rule: a ticket is claimable when all depends_on are done. Executors: work ONE ticket per session, run `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && scripts/validate-arch.sh` plus ticket acceptance before marking done. Never widen write_scope beyond the always-writable set without a HANDOFF note in the ticket's notes array.
